svg.title: The hemisphere signs are explicitly enumerated: suppressing them after choosing a decoder represen- tative would not establish a full-circle bound. Together with seven decoder orbits this gives 56 cube calculations. The delivered certificate partitions each cube into a finite prefix-free set of dyadic octree boxes. On a box, exact endpoint formulas enclose each ci, si; ci additionally has maximum one when its interval contains zero. Rational interval products and sums give an upper bound on F0 and intervals for A, B. An integer-square-root enclosure bounds √
